BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah uses this word once, asking why God should seem like a man astonished, a mighty man who cannot save. The question is the cry of a people who feel abandoned, even while they confess that the Lord is in their midst.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse gives us honest language for the dark days: we may ask God why He seems silent, and still hold that He has not left us.
